block.deathbound.jar_crown: Jar with a Crown in It
block.deathbound.jar_heart: Jar with a Heart in It
block.deathbound.jar_moth: Jar with a Moth in It
item.deathbound.deathbound_relic.lore: A chain that keeps a soul in its body.
item.deathbound.charm.bind_hint: Bind it to a Deathbound Relic.
item.deathbound.soulbound_charm.lore: Death cannot claim what is yours.
item.deathbound.seers_charm.lore: The dead see what you cannot.
item.deathbound.wraiths_charm.lore: Each soul makes you more like them.
item.deathbound.ferrymans_charm.lore: The Ferryman always takes his coin.
item.deathbound.ferrymans_charm.desc: Below: the relic takes you home.
item.deathbound.heart_of_death.desc: Bring it to the empty throne, and use it on the throne.
boss.deathbound.death.throne: The Death King, Upon the Throne
container.deathbound.relic.hint: Bind up to one of each charm
death.attack.deathbound.soul_rend.player: %1$s had their soul torn loose by %2$s
message.deathbound.relic.silent: The relic is silent. Only the Ferryman can carry you back from here.
message.deathbound.relic.bound: Death holds you here. Conquer him first.
message.deathbound.soulbound.saved: What is yours shall not be claimed by death.
message.deathbound.heart.no_relic: The heart needs a relic to beat in.
message.deathbound.heart.awakened: The relic drinks the heart. It is awake.
message.deathbound.scythe.ready: The scythe hungers: sneak and use for Soul Reap.
message.deathbound.death.bound: Death is bound to his throne. Break the Soul Anchors.
cinematic.deathbound.journey: Your life has ended. Your journey has not.
cinematic.deathbound.were_forgotten.sub: The dead keep what they took.
cinematic.deathbound.victory.sub: Bring his Heart to the empty throne.
cinematic.deathbound.rite.ask: Do you truly wish to die?
item.deathbound.hunters_charm.lore: The first one down. He never missed.
item.deathbound.hunters_charm.desc2: and hit half again as hard.
cinematic.deathbound.ending.take.sub: The dead obey you now. Up above, a new chain has started to glow.
cinematic.deathbound.ending.king.sub: Order is back, and your chain is his. Something in it has started whispering to him.
cinematic.deathbound.ending.break.sub: No King, no Door, no judge. The dead are free, and what is left down here is wild.
message.deathbound.fall.caught: Something pulls you out of the dark by your collar. The Ferryman doesn't say a word.
message.deathbound.ending.price: The King has your chain. Everything it did for you, it does for him now.
cutscene.deathbound.1.0: You sit. The throne is cold, and it fits you perfectly.
cutscene.deathbound.1.1: The chains find you. They always find the King.
cutscene.deathbound.1.2: The Warden kneels. He always kneels to whoever sits there.
cutscene.deathbound.2.0: The chains fall from the blind King. His crown was waiting under the throne. He sits.
cutscene.deathbound.2.1: "Order has a price, bearer. Your chain." Everything it gave you goes out of you, and into him.
cutscene.deathbound.2.2: At the Door, the Warden takes up his post again. The line moves. One by one, they are judged.
cutscene.deathbound.2.3: And the Lake of Souls begins to fill.
cutscene.deathbound.2.4: He turns your chain over and over in his hands. "Mine," he whispers. Not to you.
cutscene.deathbound.3.0: The Heart cracks the throne in two.
cutscene.deathbound.3.1: The Door comes down. The Warden takes off his helm, and walks away from it.
cutscene.deathbound.4.0: Behind you, the Underworld goes down into the dark. The dead go up, as lights.
item.deathbound.spent_chain.lore0: The King kept everything it could do.
item.deathbound.spent_chain.lore1: It's only a chain now. The only way home is the long one.
title.deathbound.throne_empty.sub: Bring his heart to it, and use it on the throne.
message.deathbound.heart.throne: The Heart pulls toward the Citadel. Bring it to the empty throne.
message.deathbound.ending.done: The throne has already been decided.
message.deathbound.ending.take: You sit. The throne is cold, and it fits you perfectly.
message.deathbound.ending.king: The chains fall from the blind King. He takes his crown back, and sits.
message.deathbound.ending.break: The Heart cracks the throne in two. Under your feet, the Underworld starts to come apart.
item.deathbound.open_door_charm.lore: The Door is open. For you, always.
item.deathbound.open_door_charm.desc: Use the relic to cross between
message.deathbound.relic.offhand: The chain is quiet. Keep it in your off hand... and die.
message.deathbound.soulforge.done: Aldous hammers the dead into your %s. It glows with grave-runes.
message.deathbound.soulforge.wanting: "Your %s? That's %s rune(s) and %s souls, friend. Come back when you have them."
message.deathbound.soulforge.all: "That %s is forged already. Nothing more I can do for it."
message.deathbound.soulforge.none: "You're not wearing a %s I can work, friend."
message.deathbound.ferry_keep: Everything you carried sank into the dry river. The Ferryman will be holding it.
message.deathbound.reclaim.given: "The river brought me these. They smell of you." The Ferryman hands back your belongings.
message.deathbound.reclaim.none: "The river brought me nothing of yours, bearer. Not yet."
npc.deathbound.again.ferryman: Ask, then. The river isn't going anywhere. Not anymore.
npc.deathbound.again.prophet: What else? I have time. Time is all I have.
npc.deathbound.again.king: What else? I have time. Time is all I have.
npc.deathbound.again.mira: What else? I have to keep counting.
npc.deathbound.again.lamplighter: Something else? The lamps can spare me a moment.
npc.deathbound.again.sentry: Anything else? Quickly. I am on duty.
npc.deathbound.again.kid: What? WHAT? Hurry, Tib is coming.
item.deathbound.underworld_journal.lore0: Every favor the dead have asked of you.
item.deathbound.aldous_lantern.lore0: For Mira, in the line at the Great Door.
item.deathbound.miras_ribbon.lore0: For her father, at the forge in Lantern's End.
item.deathbound.pips_ball.lore0: Knucklebones, sewn tight. The best ball.
item.deathbound.lantern_wisp.lore0: A wisp of the Lamplighter's lamp. Use to wake it, or let it sleep.
item.deathbound.lantern_wisp.lore1: It lights the dark, and rings when the dead come close.
message.deathbound.wisp.wake: The wisp wakes, and settles at your shoulder.
message.deathbound.wisp.sleep: The wisp goes back into its lantern.
journal.deathbound.title: THE UNDERWORLD JOURNAL
journal.deathbound.intro: The dead ask for things. Not much. A lantern carried, an oar found, a name remembered.
journal.deathbound.empty: Nobody has asked you for anything yet. Talk to the people down here. Some of them have been waiting a long time.
quest.deathbound.mira.title: Aldous's Lantern
quest.deathbound.mira.giver: Asked by Aldous, at the forge in Lantern's End
quest.deathbound.mira.stage1: Take Aldous's lantern to Mira, somewhere in the line of souls at the Gate. Ask the souls in line. Keep it lit: a soul flame relights it.
quest.deathbound.mira.stage2: Mira gave you her ribbon. Bring it back to Aldous.
quest.deathbound.mira.stage3: Mira is in the line, and she is not scared. Aldous knows. Done.
quest.deathbound.oar.title: The Ferryman's Oar
quest.deathbound.oar.giver: Asked by the Ferryman, at the Landing
quest.deathbound.oar.stage1: Find the Ferryman's oar, in his old boat-shed at the south edge of the Ghostwood. The roots have grown over it, so bring an axe.
quest.deathbound.oar.stage2: The oar is back with the Ferryman. Done.
quest.deathbound.lamps.title: Three Lights
quest.deathbound.lamps.giver: Asked by the Lamplighter, in Lantern's End
quest.deathbound.lamps.stage1: Bring the Lamplighter three Soul Jars (a jar and a soul, or bought from the Collector).
quest.deathbound.lamps.stage2: The lamps of Lantern's End burn a little brighter. You have a Lantern Wisp. Done.
quest.deathbound.ball.title: The Best Ball
quest.deathbound.ball.giver: Asked by Pip, in the streets of Lantern's End
quest.deathbound.ball.stage1: Find the children's ball. It rolled under the old footbridge at the Crossing, in the dry river.
quest.deathbound.ball.stage2: The children have their ball back. Done.
quest.deathbound.name.title: A Name in Tin
quest.deathbound.name.giver: Asked by the Sentry, on the Western Watch
quest.deathbound.name.stage1: Find the Sentry's tag, halfway across the broken bridge from the Watch to the Hollow. Something out there doesn't like visitors.
quest.deathbound.name.stage2: His name is Corwin. He remembers it now. Done.
temper.deathbound.effect2: Hits light up the dead, and drag at them
temper.deathbound.effect3: Every dead thing you put down gives back a little life
message.deathbound.temper.done: Clatter plunges your %1$s into the Mere. The water hisses, and lights come up off the blade. (%4$s)
message.deathbound.temper.wanting: *He counts on his fingers: %2$s Grave Rune(s), %3$s souls. Then he holds out his empty hand.*
message.deathbound.temper.none: *He taps your hand and shakes his whole head. A weapon. Something with an edge.*
message.deathbound.temper.already: *He turns your %1$s in the light and hands it back. The Mere has already had it.*
message.deathbound.temper.order: *He holds up fewer fingers. One quench at a time.*
message.deathbound.temper.gate2: *He points toward the Great Door and mimes a huge figure kneeling. Not yet.*
message.deathbound.temper.gate3: *He mimes drawing a bow, points west, and shakes his head. Not while the Hunter lives.*
item.deathbound.hunters_bow.lore0: Bone and sinew. Its arrows glow, and whatever they hit stays lit.
item.deathbound.hunters_bow.lore1: He never missed. Now you might not either.
item.deathbound.hunters_bow.lore2: Hold the draw past full and it remembers the hunt.
item.deathbound.sigil_kings.lore0: It rose out of the old King's empty tomb.
item.deathbound.sigil_kings.lore1: One of three keys to the Death King's gate.
item.deathbound.sigil_watchers.lore0: The skulls at the top of the Spire kept it.
item.deathbound.sigil_watchers.lore1: One of three keys to the Death King's gate.
item.deathbound.sigil_bell.lore0: It fell out of the bell at Lantern's End.
item.deathbound.sigil_bell.lore1: One of three keys to the Death King's gate.
puzzle.deathbound.clue_lamps: Carved over the tombs: "LIGHT THE KINGS' LAMPS IN THE ORDER THEY RULED. THE NAMELESS TOMB STAYS DARK." (Read the names on the tombs.)
puzzle.deathbound.clue_watchers: Cut into the floor: "TURN EVERY WATCHER TO LOOK OUT OF ITS WINDOW."
puzzle.deathbound.clue_bell: Cut into the bell tower: "TOLL FOR ALL EXISTING KINGS."
puzzle.deathbound.clue_gate: The gate is sealed. Three locks hold it: a crown, an eye, and a bell.
puzzle.deathbound.lamps_wrong: Out of order. Every flame goes out at once. The dead don't like being counted wrong.
puzzle.deathbound.lamps_nameless: That tomb has no King in it yet. Every flame goes out at once.
puzzle.deathbound.hint_lamp: A cold grave lamp. Use it to light it.
puzzle.deathbound.hint_skull: This skull is staring in at you. Use it to turn it.
puzzle.deathbound.skull_out: This one looks out now. (%s of 4)
puzzle.deathbound.skull_in: It still looks in. (%s of 4 look out)
puzzle.deathbound.names_deep: The Kings' names are cut too deep to break.
puzzle.deathbound.after_warden: Beyond the Door, the Death King's gate is sealed with three locks. The Prophet in the Tomb of Kings knows where the keys are hidden.
puzzle.deathbound.bell_wrong: The last toll fades. Nothing answers.
puzzle.deathbound.solved0: Something rises out of the empty tomb.
puzzle.deathbound.solved1: The skulls settle. Something drops to the floor between them.
puzzle.deathbound.solved2: The bell keeps ringing after you stop. Something falls out of it.
puzzle.deathbound.lock_filled: The lock takes the sigil. %s of 3.
puzzle.deathbound.gate_open.sub: The Death King is waiting for you.
item.deathbound.ferry_coin.lore0: A coin from up top, worn smooth by a thumb.
collector.deathbound.ferry_coin: A fare from the living world. The Ferryman never gives these up. Unless it hurts to look at.
item.deathbound.wooden_horse.lore0: A child's toy. One ear longer than the other.
collector.deathbound.wooden_horse: Carved by a man who wasn't a carver. Look at the ears. He loved her, whoever she was.
item.deathbound.kings_quill.lore0: Every law of the throne was written with this.
collector.deathbound.kings_quill: Funny. Read the laws back and every one of them favours the King.
item.deathbound.warden_seal.lore0: He stamped every soul he ever judged.
collector.deathbound.warden_seal: Nine million stamps. Not once on himself. He never thought he deserved judging.
item.deathbound.melted_chains.lore0: Ten chains, fused into one cold lump.
collector.deathbound.melted_chains: Someone was very afraid of being replaced. Ten times afraid.
item.deathbound.kings_ring.lore0: Taken from the old King's hand.
collector.deathbound.kings_ring: Pulled off his finger while he screamed. He'd worn it eight hundred years. He'll want it back.
collector.deathbound.hunters_arrowhead: He makes them from what he hunts. He was here before the river was, you know.
item.deathbound.last_drop.lore0: All that's left of the Lake of Souls.
collector.deathbound.last_drop: Hold it to your ear. Somebody in there is still singing.
collector.deathbound.nothing: Nothing? Then why are you standing in my vault? Go and find me something forgotten.
collector.deathbound.done: You've brought me everything. Go home. Before you become a thing someone collects.
collector.deathbound.complete: All eight. Then here is the one thing nobody else will tell you: the first one down never wanted the throne. Every King since has. Ask yourself which of them got to go home.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.1: I left the lamp burning. Someone should blow it out.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.2: He weighed me. He said nothing. He always says nothing.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.3: Don't look at the Door too long. It looks back.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.4: I was a baker. I think I was a baker.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.5: How long have we been walking?
deathbound.lost_soul.line.6: There used to be water here. I remember being wet.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.7: My name... it was right here...
deathbound.lost_soul.line.8: You're warm. Why are you warm?
deathbound.lost_soul.line.9: The ones who fall out of line get up again. Wrong.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.10: Mother promised there would be light.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.11: The Ferryman has my coin. I paid. I paid.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.12: Don't take off the chain. Not here.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.13: He eats one of us every night. You can hear it from the line.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.14: I can't feel my hands. I can't feel your hand.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.15: Kings walk in this line too. They hate it.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.16: Turn back. Or don't. None of us did.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.17: The old King made us work before we could rest. At least we rested.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.18: A little girl asked me if I'd seen her father. I said yes. I lied.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.19: When the Warden looks at you, don't blink.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.20: The Warden cried when he knelt. I saw it.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.21: Another chain? Oh no. Oh, not again.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.22: Whoever sits up there, the line never gets shorter.
deathbound.lost_soul.line.23: I heard a bowstring out past the edge. Nobody goes past the edge.
deathbound.say.warden.start: Stop. The throne has a King. The living do not pass.
deathbound.say.warden.half: I serve the throne. Whoever sits on it.
deathbound.say.warden.defeat: Enough... Kill him, and I will serve you.
deathbound.say.death.wake: So the last chain found a neck.
deathbound.say.death.rise: I melted every chain but yours. I should have looked harder.
deathbound.say.death.beast: You want the throne? Look what it made of me!
deathbound.say.death.low: I came down here to win. I won. Why does it feel like this?
deathbound.say.death.defeat: It'll eat you too... the throne... it eats everyone...
deathbound.say.hunter.start: Another one with a chain. Run. It's better when they run.
deathbound.say.hunter.half: Good. You learn. The ones who learn last longest.
deathbound.say.hunter.defeat: At last... one who came for me, and not for the throne.
deathbound.lingering.arrival.0: The Ferryman told me to wait. That was a long time ago.
deathbound.lingering.arrival.1: You came down on purpose? Why would anyone...
deathbound.lingering.arrival.2: Your heart is beating. It's so loud.
deathbound.lingering.crossing.0: Every bridge comes back here. I've tried them all.
deathbound.lingering.crossing.1: The river split here once. Left to the trees, right to the lamps.
deathbound.lingering.crossing.2: The pillars hum when nobody's listening.
deathbound.lingering.ghostwood.0: The trees remember being trees. That's the worst part.
deathbound.lingering.ghostwood.1: Something is buried under the old root. Something with a lock.
deathbound.lingering.ghostwood.2: Don't rest here. The roots listen.
deathbound.lingering.village.0: Is it supper yet? I set the table. I always set the table.
deathbound.lingering.village.1: The bell rang and nobody came.
deathbound.lingering.village.2: Aldous digs and digs. Tell him she isn't in the ground.
deathbound.lingering.crypt.0: Shh. The Kings are sleeping. Don't wake the others.
deathbound.lingering.crypt.1: The blind one below talks to himself. He keeps saying 'my throne'.
deathbound.lingering.crypt.2: There's a wall down here that isn't. I walk through it sometimes.
deathbound.lingering.spire.0: We built it to see the far shore. There is no far shore.
deathbound.lingering.spire.1: The wind up here sounds like my name.
deathbound.lingering.spire.2: There's a man under the floor. He counts things. He counted me.
deathbound.lingering.watch.0: They all turned and looked up at me. All at once.
deathbound.lingering.watch.1: What day is it? I keep the log. I keep the log.
deathbound.lingering.watch.2: Out west, past the edge, something with one eye. Don't go west.
deathbound.lingering.gate.0: He weighed me twice. I don't know what that means.
deathbound.lingering.gate.1: Stand in line long enough and you forget why.
deathbound.lingering.gate.2: Near the front of the line there's a little girl who counts us.
deathbound.lingering.citadel.0: This was all water once. We floated. It was so quiet.
deathbound.lingering.citadel.1: He drinks from the Lake every night. There's nothing left to drink.
deathbound.lingering.citadel.2: Four anchors hold him up. Break them and he has to stand.
area.deathbound.spire.line: It never saw the far shore.
area.deathbound.watch.line: The sentry is still at his post.
area.deathbound.citadel.line: Built on a lake drunk dry.
area.deathbound.mere.line: The one water he never drank.
talk.deathbound.ferryman.back.0: Back again. The river's no wetter.
talk.deathbound.ferryman.back.1: *He leans on his pole and waits for you to speak.*
talk.deathbound.ferryman.back.2: Ask, then. I'm not going anywhere.
talk.deathbound.gravedigger.back.0: Back again, friend? The forge is hot.
talk.deathbound.gravedigger.back.1: *He wipes his hands on his apron.* What can I do for you?
talk.deathbound.prophet.back.0: You're back. I can hear your chain.
talk.deathbound.prophet.back.1: *He turns his blind face toward you.* Ask.
talk.deathbound.collector.back.2: Back so soon? What have you found?
talk.deathbound.bonesmith.back.1: *He taps the water, then your weapon.*
talk.deathbound.bonesmith.ask: *He tilts his whole head. Go on.*
talk.deathbound.mira.back.0: You're back! I was at seven hundred and two.
talk.deathbound.lamplighter.back.1: *He lifts his lamp to see you better.*
talk.deathbound.sentry.back.1: *He doesn't take his eyes off the west.*
talk.deathbound.kid.back.0: You came back! Do you want to play?
talk.deathbound.kid.back.1: *Pip waves a bony arm.* Hi! Hi!
puzzle.deathbound.already_solved: It has already given up its sigil. Nothing more stirs.
deathbound.lost_soul.gift: The Lost Soul presses something cold into your hand.
death.attack.deathbound.soul_bolt: %1$s was struck down by a soul bolt
death.attack.deathbound.soul_bolt.player: %1$s was struck down by %2$s's soul bolt
item.deathbound.underworld_journal.lore1: Sneak + use a found book to file it inside.
journal.deathbound.lore_count:
Books kept: %s

Sneak + use any book you find to file it here instead of carrying it.
quest.deathbound.mira.lantern_gutters: The lantern gutters. It can take %s more.
quest.deathbound.mira.lantern_out: Aldous's lantern goes out. Hold it to a soul flame to light it again.
item.deathbound.aldous_lantern.guttering: Guttering: %s more hits and it goes out.
item.deathbound.aldous_lantern.out: Out. Relight it at a soul flame.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.near.0: A little girl? She's right around here. Listen, you can hear her counting.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.near.1: The girl with the gap in her teeth? She was just here.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.near.2: Shh. Hear that? Somebody's counting. That's her.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.ahead_close.0: A little girl? A bit further up, toward the Door.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.ahead_close.1: She's a little way ahead of me. Not far.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.ahead_close.2: Further up the line. Only a few souls ahead.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.ahead_far.0: A little girl? Way up ahead, near the Door.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.ahead_far.1: Keep going toward the Door. It's a long way.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.ahead_far.2: She's much further up. I've been behind her the whole time.
I passed a little girl a moment ago. Just behind us.
She's back a little. She keeps letting people go in front of her.
Turn around. She's not far back.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.behind_far.0: A little girl? Way back. She keeps letting everyone go first.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.behind_far.1: A long way back down the line.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.behind_far.2: I passed her ages ago. She was counting.
quest.deathbound.mira.clue.with_side: %s On the %s side of the path.
quest.deathbound.name.ambush: Something moves out in the Hollow. Run.
quest.deathbound.name.ambush_over: The arrows stop. Whatever it was, it let you go.
quest.deathbound.oar.wake: The Ghostwood wakes. Get out of the trees.
quest.deathbound.oar.wake_over: The trees go still behind you.
advancements.deathbound.root.title: DeathBound
advancements.deathbound.return_fare.desc: Make it back to the living world.
advancements.deathbound.bound.title: Bound to You
advancements.deathbound.bound.descriptio: Bind a charm to the Deathbound Relic.
advancements.deathbound.full_hand.title: Full Hand
advancements.deathbound.full_hand.descri: Fill every charm slot on the Relic.
Let a hit pass through you with the Phantom Charm.
advancements.deathbound.soulforged.title: Soulforged
advancements.deathbound.soulforged.descr: Have Aldous forge souls into your armor.
advancements.deathbound.errand.title: An Errand for the Dead
advancements.deathbound.errand.descripti: Finish a task for someone in the Underworld.
advancements.deathbound.keep_it_lit.desc: Bring Mira her father's lantern, still burning.
advancements.deathbound.every_errand.des: Finish every task in the Journal.
advancements.deathbound.forgotten_things: Bring the Collector all eight artifacts.
advancements.deathbound.warden_falls.des: Defeat Death's Guard at the Great Door.
advancements.deathbound.three_locks.desc: Fill the three seals and open the Citadel.
advancements.deathbound.ending_king.desc: Give the throne back to the King.
journal.deathbound.progress.lantern_out: Lantern: out. Hold it to a soul flame to light it again.
journal.deathbound.progress.no_clue: Nobody in the line has told you anything yet.
journal.deathbound.progress.ribbon: Mira's ribbon is in your pack.
journal.deathbound.progress.jars: Soul Jars in your pack: %s of 3.
item.deathbound.story_book.hint: Use to read. Sneak + use to keep it in your Journal.
journal.deathbound.stories_none: Notes, journals, last words. When you read one, it's kept here.
journal.deathbound.stories_hint: Click a title to read it again.
story.deathbound.sand_keeps_time.title: Sand Keeps Time
story.deathbound.sand_keeps_time.author: Talia, treasure hunter
story.deathbound.sand_keeps_time.p1: Day one. A temple in the desert, and a blue stone in the floor shaped like an eye. I knew the gold was under it.
story.deathbound.sand_keeps_time.p2: I dug, and the floor fell away. Gold, diamonds, and walls too high to climb.
story.deathbound.sand_keeps_time.p3: Day six. I would trade every gem in here for one loaf of bread.
story.deathbound.sand_keeps_time.p4: Sand falls from the ceiling, grain by grain. I think it's counting for me.
story.deathbound.three_skulls.title: Three Skulls
story.deathbound.three_skulls.author: Corin
story.deathbound.three_skulls.p1: Soul sand in the shape of a T. Three black skulls on top. I placed the last one, and the sky went dark.
story.deathbound.three_skulls.p2: It had three heads, and all three knew my name. My sword was a twig. My armor was paper.
story.deathbound.three_skulls.p3: I wanted to be a hero. I was only the one who woke it. Sorry, everyone who lived nearby.
story.deathbound.bait.title: Bait
story.deathbound.bait.author: Edda, miner
story.deathbound.bait.p1: Four diamonds, shining at the bottom of a cave. I ran to them.
story.deathbound.bait.p2: The stone under my feet broke. Under it was something orange, and loud, and very warm.
story.deathbound.bait.p3: If you see diamonds next to lava, walk away. Some things shine only to bring you closer.
story.deathbound.a_soft_hiss.title: A Soft Hiss
story.deathbound.a_soft_hiss.author: Bram, farmer
story.deathbound.a_soft_hiss.p1: I built my house with my own hands. Oak walls, a glass window, a field of wheat.
story.deathbound.a_soft_hiss.p2: One evening I stood in the field, watching the wheat move in the wind. Then I heard a soft hiss behind me.
story.deathbound.a_soft_hiss.p3: I never turned around. I'm glad. Some faces you don't need to see.
story.deathbound.go_to_bed.title: Go To Bed
story.deathbound.go_to_bed.author: Lio
story.deathbound.go_to_bed.p1: Three nights without sleep. There was always one more tunnel, one more ore.
story.deathbound.go_to_bed.p2: On the fourth night the sky grew wings. They were blue and torn, and they screamed as they fell on me.
story.deathbound.go_to_bed.p3: If you are reading this, go to bed. The night remembers who stays awake.
story.deathbound.under_me_stars.title: Under Me, Stars
story.deathbound.under_me_stars.author: Saro
story.deathbound.under_me_stars.p1: I beat the dragon. I stood at the edge of the world and laughed.
story.deathbound.under_me_stars.p2: A tall dark thing was staring at me. I took one step back.
story.deathbound.under_me_stars.p3: There was no ground. Only stars above me and stars below me, and a long, quiet fall. It was almost pretty.
story.deathbound.wear_the_gold.title: Wear The Gold
story.deathbound.wear_the_gold.author: Fenna
story.deathbound.wear_the_gold.p1: Everyone said the pig folk love gold. I took my gold boots off. They looked silly.
story.deathbound.wear_the_gold.p2: The pig folk saw my bare feet. Then there were a lot of them, and they were very fast.
story.deathbound.wear_the_gold.p3: Wear the gold. Even if it looks silly. Especially then.
story.deathbound.a_bed_in_the_nether.p1: It was late, and home was far. I thought: I'll just sleep here, in my red bed.
story.deathbound.a_bed_in_the_nether.p3: My last thought was how pretty the fire looked on the red stone. Strange, what you think about at the end.
story.deathbound.the_cat_is_patient.p1: I had a long life in a little house by the river. A cat, a garden, a good view.
story.deathbound.the_cat_is_patient.p2: One night I lay down and didn't get up. I wasn't scared. I thought I would see the river again.
story.deathbound.the_cat_is_patient.p3: But this river is dry, and the line is long. I'm still waiting, my cat in my arms. He is patient. So am I.
story.deathbound.last_torch.title: The Last Torch
story.deathbound.last_torch.author: Wren, explorer
story.deathbound.last_torch.p1: I took sixty-four torches into the cave and placed one every ten steps.
story.deathbound.last_torch.p2: At the bottom I found iron, gold, a whole wall of coal. I placed my last torch and kept digging.
story.deathbound.last_torch.p3: When I turned around, the way back was dark. Something in the dark was putting my torches out, one by one.
story.deathbound.last_torch.p4: It never came closer. It didn't need to. It only had to wait.
story.deathbound.light_as_snow.title: Light As Snow
story.deathbound.light_as_snow.author: Oskar
story.deathbound.light_as_snow.p1: The snow on the mountain looked soft enough to sleep in.
story.deathbound.light_as_snow.p2: I stepped off the path for a better view. The snow opened like a mouth, and I sank.
story.deathbound.light_as_snow.p3: It's very quiet under the snow. After a while my hands stopped hurting. That's how I knew.
story.deathbound.wings.title: Wings
story.deathbound.wings.author: Juno
story.deathbound.wings.p1: I found wings on a ship at the end of the world, floating over nothing.
story.deathbound.wings.p2: I flew home over the sea, laughing. Seventeen rockets. Then sixteen. Then none.
story.deathbound.wings.p3: The sea was a long way down. I had plenty of time to count the rockets I should have brought.
story.deathbound.shh.title: Shh
story.deathbound.shh.author: Ada, explorer
story.deathbound.shh.p1: Deep under the caves there is a city. Grey stone, blue fire, and black moss that whispers when you step on it.
story.deathbound.shh.p2: I walked softly. I held my breath. Then I opened a chest, and the moss screamed.
story.deathbound.shh.p3: The thing that came has no eyes. It doesn't need them. It heard my heart, and my heart was very loud.
story.deathbound.bad_omen.title: Bad Omen
story.deathbound.bad_omen.author: Captain Hode
story.deathbound.bad_omen.p1: I killed a raider captain and took his banner. It looked good on my wall.
story.deathbound.bad_omen.p2: When I walked into the village, the air felt wrong. Then the bell rang. Then the horns.
story.deathbound.bad_omen.p3: They came in waves, with axes and spells and a beast that walked through my door. The villagers hid. I didn't have time to.
story.deathbound.under_the_sea.title: Under The Sea
story.deathbound.under_the_sea.author: Hob, diver
story.deathbound.under_the_sea.p1: A temple under the sea, glowing green from inside. I swam down to look.
story.deathbound.under_the_sea.p2: A great eye opened in the water and looked back at me. My arms went weak.
story.deathbound.under_the_sea.p3: Then the eye began to glow. I didn't know fish could do that. I know now.
story.deathbound.kid.title: Kid
story.deathbound.kid.author: Hal, shepherd
story.deathbound.kid.p1: I climbed the mountain for a goat horn. They say it sounds like the wind calling you home.
story.deathbound.kid.p2: A goat lowered its head and looked at me. I thought it was being friendly.
story.deathbound.kid.p3: I never got the horn. I got a very good view of the valley, very quickly.
story.deathbound.channeling.title: Channeling
story.deathbound.channeling.author: Ines, smith
story.deathbound.channeling.p1: Storms never scared me. I had a new trident, and the book said it could call the lightning.
story.deathbound.channeling.p2: A zombie came at me through the rain. I threw the trident. It was standing very close.
story.deathbound.channeling.p3: The sky answered. It doesn't care who it hits. Remember that, when you call it.
story.deathbound.small_blue_spiders.p1: An old mine full of rails and cobwebs. I followed the rails down into the dark.
story.deathbound.small_blue_spiders.p2: Small blue spiders came out of a cage. Then more. Then more.
story.deathbound.small_blue_spiders.p3: Every bite made me sicker. I found a minecart and sat down in it to rest. I'm still resting.
story.deathbound.straight_down.title: Straight Down
story.deathbound.straight_down.author: Nils, miner
story.deathbound.straight_down.p1: Everyone says never dig straight down. I thought it was just something people say.
story.deathbound.straight_down.p2: I dug down and down. It was quick, and the stone was quiet.
story.deathbound.straight_down.p3: Then the floor broke. Under it was a cave so big it had its own wind. I fell for a long time.
story.deathbound.the_nice_lady.title: The Nice Lady
story.deathbound.the_nice_lady.author: Pim
story.deathbound.the_nice_lady.p1: A little hut in the swamp, on thin wooden legs. A lady in a purple robe lived there, with a cat.
story.deathbound.the_nice_lady.p2: I waved. She smiled, and threw a bottle at me. Then another.
story.deathbound.the_nice_lady.p3: I grew slow, then weak, then sick. She laughed the whole time. The cat watched. It never blinked.
story.deathbound.return_to_sender.title: Return To Sender
story.deathbound.return_to_sender.author: Dov
story.deathbound.return_to_sender.p1: I built a bridge across the lava lake, one block wide.
story.deathbound.return_to_sender.p2: Something white floated out of the smoke. It cried like a baby, and spat fire at me.
story.deathbound.return_to_sender.p3: You can hit the fire back. I found that out on the way down.
story.deathbound.the_stone_moved.title: The Stone Moved
story.deathbound.the_stone_moved.author: Uma
story.deathbound.the_stone_moved.p1: Deep underground there's an old stone fort, all halls and iron doors. I went looking for the way to the End.
story.deathbound.the_stone_moved.p2: I broke one stone in the wall, and a little grey bug crawled out. I hit it.
story.deathbound.the_stone_moved.p3: Then the walls began to move. Every stone was full of them. If you meet the first one, don't hit it. Just run.
story.deathbound.bad_trade.title: Bad Trade
story.deathbound.bad_trade.author: Rook
story.deathbound.bad_trade.p1: The villager wanted twenty emeralds for one old book. I got angry, and I hit him.
story.deathbound.bad_trade.p2: Behind me, something very big and made of iron turned around. It was holding a red flower.
story.deathbound.bad_trade.p3: It threw me into the sky. For a moment I could see the whole village, small and safe. Then I came down.
story.deathbound.cactus_fence.title: Cactus Fence
story.deathbound.cactus_fence.author: Della
story.deathbound.cactus_fence.p1: The zombies kept walking into my garden. So I grew a cactus fence all the way around it.
story.deathbound.cactus_fence.p2: It worked. Nothing got in. Then one night a skeleton shot at me from the dark, and I stepped back.
story.deathbound.cactus_fence.p3: I was very proud of that fence. It was a good fence. It still is.
story.deathbound.note_ferry.title: Nailed to the post
story.deathbound.note_ferry.author: The Ferryman
story.deathbound.note_ferry.p2: Scratched under it, in another hand: he takes charms too. Ask nicely.
story.deathbound.note_lights.title: Pinned to a tree
story.deathbound.note_lights.p1: Don't follow the lights between the trees. They aren't lanterns.
story.deathbound.note_marks.title: Pinned to a tree
story.deathbound.note_marks.author: R.
story.deathbound.note_marks.p1: Day three in the woods. I mark every tree I pass with an X, so I don't walk in circles.
story.deathbound.note_marks.p2: This morning every tree has an X. I didn't make most of them.
story.deathbound.note_shed.title: Tacked to the bark
story.deathbound.note_shed.author: a friend
story.deathbound.note_shed.p1: If you came for the old boat shed, take what you need and run.
story.deathbound.note_shed.p2: The roots are slow. The wood is not.
story.deathbound.note_list.title: A list on the table
story.deathbound.note_list.author: Bea
story.deathbound.note_list.p1: Bread. Candles. Thread for Mira's ribbon.
story.deathbound.note_list.p3: Feed the cat. (There's no cat. There used to be a cat.)
story.deathbound.note_yours.title: Left on the table
story.deathbound.note_yours.author: Odo
story.deathbound.note_yours.p1: To whoever finds this house: it's yours. The kettle sticks and the roof leaks on the left.
story.deathbound.note_yours.p2: I've gone to stand in the line. Don't wait up.
story.deathbound.note_tib.title: Folded very small
story.deathbound.note_tib.author: Tib
story.deathbound.note_tib.p1: Pip says I kicked his ball off the bridge on purpose.
story.deathbound.note_lamps.title: The Lamplighter's rounds
story.deathbound.note_lamps.author: L.
story.deathbound.note_lamps.p1: The well. The bell tower. The bridge. The forge. The gate.
story.deathbound.note_lamps.p2: Fewer every night. Light the ones that are left. Don't count the rest.
